sol_living_standard = {
	map_color = {
		# SOL amounts: red at 0, yellow at world average, green at 3x world average.
		if = { limit = { is_land = yes has_owner = yes has_variable = sol_location_sol }
			if = { limit = { sol_map_living_standard_relative_value < 1 }
				lerp = { min_color = rgb { 210 70 55 } max_color = rgb { 235 205 100 } factor = { value = sol_map_living_standard_below_factor } }
			}
			else = { lerp = { min_color = rgb { 235 205 100 } max_color = rgb { 50 180 90 } factor = { value = sol_map_living_standard_above_factor } } }
		}
		else = { value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR }
	}
	legend_key = { desc = "GLS_MAP_LEGEND_HIGH" color = rgb { 50 180 90 } }
	legend_key = { desc = "GLS_MAP_LEGEND_MID" color = rgb { 235 205 100 } }
	legend_key = { desc = "GLS_MAP_LEGEND_LOW" color = rgb { 210 70 55 } }
	tooltip_key = {
		if = { limit = { is_land = yes has_owner = yes has_variable = sol_location_sol sol_map_living_standard_relative_value >= 2 } value = MAPMODE_SOL_LIVING_STANDARD_TT_HIGH }
		else_if = { limit = { is_land = yes has_owner = yes has_variable = sol_location_sol sol_map_living_standard_relative_value >= 1 } value = MAPMODE_SOL_LIVING_STANDARD_TT_MID }
		else_if = { limit = { is_land = yes has_owner = yes has_variable = sol_location_sol sol_map_living_standard_relative_value >= 0.5 } value = MAPMODE_SOL_LIVING_STANDARD_TT_LOW }
		else_if = { limit = { is_land = yes has_owner = yes has_variable = sol_location_sol } value = MAPMODE_SOL_LIVING_STANDARD_TT_VERY_LOW }
		else_if = { limit = { is_land = yes has_owner = yes } value = MAPMODE_SOL_LIVING_STANDARD_TT_UNCACHED }
		else = { value = MAPMODE_SOL_LIVING_STANDARD_TT_WATER }
	}
	small_map_names = location
	medium_map_names = location
	large_map_names = location
	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location
	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no
	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no
	category = economy
	index = 0
	map_markers = { all = no }
	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2
		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.25
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = 0.5
		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
	}
	color_refresh_counters = { Month }
	color_and_names_refresh_counters = { Month LocationOwnerChanged CountryStatus }
}

sol_purchasing_power = {
	map_color = {
		# Alpha - 1, with the same -100% / 0% / +200% anchors as the HUD.
		if = { limit = { is_land = yes has_owner = yes has_variable = sol_location_liquid_funds has_variable = sol_location_base_total_spending var:sol_location_base_total_spending > 0 }
			if = { limit = { sol_map_purchasing_power_value < 0 }
				lerp = { min_color = rgb { 210 70 55 } max_color = rgb { 235 205 100 } factor = { value = sol_map_purchasing_power_value add = 1 min = 0 max = 1 } }
			}
			else = { lerp = { min_color = rgb { 235 205 100 } max_color = rgb { 50 180 90 } factor = { value = sol_map_purchasing_power_value divide = 2 min = 0 max = 1 } } }
